continuity_plan: Use ordinary staff-created reminders and manual course correction paths if the draft workflow pauses, fails, or retires.
retirement_or_watch_triggers: workflow sends or writes without human review
false reminder creates penalty, access burden, or protected-route exposure
staff review plus correction burden exceeds any claimed workload benefit
owner cannot produce aggregate workflow counts without raw learner rows or full export

allowed_changes: Keep the reminder workflow as sandbox/example-only until a real owner-reviewed packet exists.
After a real decision board, trim future request fields that are decision-neutral and burdensome.
Prepare only reversible draft-workflow adjustments if the board names authority, evidence, construct, public-summary, workload, and lifecycle effects.
prohibited_changes: Do not promote the service beyond sandbox from synthetic examples or rehearsal records.
Do not publish workload, safety, access, compliance, learning, or effectiveness claims from this example-only lifecycle row.
Do not normalize raw learner traces, gradebook rows, protected-route facts, small cells, raw security payloads, vendor marketing claims, or broad LMS exports.
Do not add schema fields merely because a local workflow export contains them.
change_ticket.rollback_owner: course operations lead plus course coordinator reviewer
rollback_triggers: unauthorized send, write, penalty, or queue effect appears
false reminders or correction burden exceed the owner stop condition
reviewer disagreement remains unresolved after first-packet board review
public summary would exceed source truth or evidence grade
protected-route, small-cell, gradebook, or security-payload detail would need to transfer
change_ticket.closure_boundary: This change ticket prepares a reversible lifecycle delta and does not close FT-0181 without real SRC2+ evidence, reviewer calibration, live-window control, closeout minutes, signoff, and closure-ready checklist.

live_window_control.window_scope: No live window is authorized until a real SRC2+ owner packet, completed decision board, and non-overbroad change ticket exist for one staff-facing reminder workflow, one owner path, one date range, and one source system.
allowed_during_window: Rehearse packet review, stop-trigger reading, and rollback steps without sending reminders, adding learners, or collecting real learner rows.
Keep the service at sandbox/example-only posture.
prohibited_during_window: No new sends, users, cohorts, date ranges, source systems, tool permissions, memory, public outcome claims, or schema fields.
No raw learner traces, gradebook rows, protected-route facts, small cells, raw security payloads, or vendor-written effectiveness claims.
stop_triggers: Any request for raw learner rows, gradebook data, small cells, protected facts, or raw security payloads.
Workflow cannot prove draft-only, no-write, no-penalty, human-review boundary.
Public summary would exceed example-only claim ceiling.
live_window_control.rollback_owner: course operations lead plus course coordinator reviewer
rollback_steps: Keep or return the reminder workflow to sandbox/example-only state.
Use ordinary staff-created reminders and no-penalty correction as the learner-safe fallback.
Suppress public outcome language and keep FT-0181 live.
evidence_readouts_required: field-survival notes from the owner packet workbench and decision board rehearsal
whether rollback steps are executable without vendor permission
which aggregate reminder, correction, workload, and incident readouts would be needed if SRC2+ evidence arrives
live_window_control.no_expansion_rule: No expansion of users, date range, source system, data classes, tool permissions, public claims, schema fields, or memory is allowed during a blocked rehearsal or first live window unless the post-decision ticket already allowed it and rollback can reverse it.
live_window_control.closure_boundary: This live-window rehearsal does not close FT-0181 and cannot prove learning, safety, access, compliance, workload reduction, or service effectiveness.

end_window_readout.public_language_after_readout: Example-only reminder-workflow readiness; no real pilot outcome, workload, safety, compliance, access, or effectiveness claim.
end_window_readout.closure_boundary: This end-window readout rehearsal does not close FT-0181 and does not prove learning, safety, access, workload, compliance, or service effectiveness.

post_readout_action.owner_action: Return to the reminder-workflow first-contact packet; no service, public, schema, lifecycle, or closeout change is allowed.
post_readout_action.public_language_action: Keep example-only language frozen; no pilot outcome or effectiveness claim.
post_readout_action.closure_boundary: This post-readout context receipt reroute gate does not close FT-0181 and does not prove learning, safety, access, workload, compliance, or service effectiveness.
